title.zh: JPMorgan Sees Bitcoin Outperforming U.S. Stocks and Gold Over Next Decade
title.en: JPMorgan Sees Bitcoin Outperforming U.S. Stocks and Gold Over Next Decade

current_state.zh: JPMorgan Asset Management included Bitcoin in its long-term capital market assumptions for the first time, projecting a 10% compound annual return over 10-15 years — above U.S. large-cap stocks at 7.5% and gold at 5.5% — with 55% annualized volatility.
